meta.title: DSH Bridge — Remote Access & Security
meta.description: Scan the QR code to keep using DeepSeek Harness on mobile or public networks when you're away from your computer. One-tap LAN QR code, Cloudflare public tunnel, self-hosted tunnel, and WeChat / QQ / Lark / Telegram bots (multi-workspace / session persistence / media / card approval / streaming output), no public server required.
